GraceRequirements.Annotation: Distribution package for the GRACE methodology: canonical skills, packaged mirror, Claude Code marketplace manifest, OpenPackage manifest, and the @osovv/grace-cli Bun-based CLI (grace lint, grace module, grace file, grace status, grace verification, grace afk, grace evolve).
GraceRequirements.Keywords: grace, methodology, skills-marketplace, cli, lint, knowledge-graph, contracts, verification

Goals.Goal: Ship and maintain the GRACE methodology as a Claude Code marketplace plugin plus an npm-published CLI, with a self-dogfooded reference project so agents cannot forget the framework they ship.
Keep the canonical skills under skills/grace and the packaged mirror under plugins/grace/skills/grace byte-for-byte synchronized.
Keep grace-marketplace itself a GRACE-managed project as the reference example for the .grace artifact model.

Users.User: Engineers and agents working in GRACE-managed repositories via the Claude Code plugin or the grace CLI.

Constraints.Constraint: GRACE is domain-specific (contract-first, graph-anchored, verification-first); it is not a generic engineering-advice framework and the skills are not interchangeable with plain prompting rules.
Drift between canonical skills/grace/* and packaged plugins/grace/skills/grace/* is prevented by scripts/validate-marketplace.ts and must hold on every change.
Agents must not forget GRACE activation; mitigated by the grace-bootstrap meta-skill, the SessionStart hook, and the CLAUDE.md preamble.
Every SKILL.md keeps the three hardening sections (Common Rationalizations, When NOT to Use, Verification); grace lint warns on drift.
